components.css: :host{--ground:#141517;--chrome:#0f1012;--raise:#1a1b1e;--raise-2:#212327;--rule:#2a2c30;--rule-2:#36383d;--rule-3:#4a4c51;--ink:#ece8df;--ink-2:#bdb9b0;--ink-3:#8f8c85;--ink-4:#66645f;--live:#4cc96f;--warn:#e8b931;--bad:#e5574e;--rec:#ef4b4b;--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)} .ds-seg{font-family:Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--rule-3);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ground)} .ds-seg button{font:inherit;padding:6px 13px;border:none;border-right:1px solid var(--rule-2);background:none;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 86;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,color .15s} .ds-seg button:last-child{border-right:0} .ds-seg button:hover:not(.on){background:var(--raise-2);color:var(--ink)} .ds-seg button.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--ground)} .ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:1.5px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:-3px}

components.css: :host{--ground:#141517;--chrome:#0f1012;--raise:#1a1b1e;--raise-2:#212327;--rule:#2a2c30;--rule-2:#36383d;--rule-3:#4a4c51;--ink:#ece8df;--ink-2:#bdb9b0;--ink-3:#8f8c85;--ink-4:#66645f;--live:#4cc96f;--warn:#e8b931;--bad:#e5574e;--rec:#ef4b4b;--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)} .ds-rail{font-family:Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif;width:92px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:12px 0;background:var(--chrome);border-right:1px solid var(--rule)} .ds-ri{font:inherit;position:relative;width:72px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:8px 0 7px;border:none;border-radius:4px;background:none;color:var(--ink-3);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,color .15s} .ds-ri svg{width:20px;height:20px;margin:6px 0 3px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round} .ds-ri span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 72;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase} .ds-ri b{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 86;color:var(--ink-3)} .ds-ri:hover{background:var(--raise);color:var(--ink-2)} .ds-ri.on{background:var(--raise-2);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-2)} .ds-ri:focus-visible{outline:1.5px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:2px} .ds-pip{position:absolute;top:7px;right:8px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink-4)} .ds-pip.live{background:var(--live)} .ds-pip.off{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-4)}

components.name: Strip Tabs
components.description: Profile and preset tabs: an ink underline marks selection, a green dot marks the one live on the device.
components.css: :host{--ground:#141517;--chrome:#0f1012;--raise:#1a1b1e;--raise-2:#212327;--rule:#2a2c30;--rule-2:#36383d;--rule-3:#4a4c51;--ink:#ece8df;--ink-2:#bdb9b0;--ink-3:#8f8c85;--ink-4:#66645f;--live:#4cc96f;--warn:#e8b931;--bad:#e5574e;--rec:#ef4b4b;--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)} .ds-strip{font-family:Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;height:44px;padding:0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--ground)} .ds-stab{font:inherit;position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 12px;border:none;background:none;color:var(--ink-3);font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s} .ds-stab i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-4)} .ds-stab.live i{background:var(--live);box-shadow:none} .ds-stab.stored i{background:var(--ink-3);box-shadow:none} .ds-stab:hover,.ds-stab.sel{color:var(--ink)} .ds-stab.sel::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:-1px;height:2px;background:var(--ink)} .ds-stab:focus-visible{outline:1.5px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:-4px}

narrative.overview:
Every device reads its live state off its own rating plate, the printed spec label under real hardware: ruled cells, tiny condensed captions, firm values. The window is warm graphite with silver-white label ink, hairline rules and 3px corners. Nothing glows. The two white devices stand as product photos on a soft floor light, and everything you can know about them sits beneath them in ruled cells that never move; when the hardware changes a value, the value changes in place.

Density is that of a working tool, not a showroom: a 92px rail of device thumbnails, page tabs in the title bar, a canvas with a plate across its top, and a raised side panel of settings sections divided by hairlines. The whole system runs on one variable typeface, Archivo, with the width axis doing the work: condensed caps for captions, semi-condensed tabular figures for values, normal width for reading text.

Colour is almost entirely neutral. Signal green appears only where something is connected or on right now, so a glance at the window answers "what is actually running" without reading; yellow asks for attention and red marks a fault. The vendor default this replaces (near-black with violet-to-blue gradients, glowing tiles, tracked uppercase labels everywhere) is explicitly rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Warm graphite ground, silver-white label ink, three quieter inks.
Rating plates: ruled cells, condensed caps caption over a firm tabular value.
Hairline rules and 3px corners; no glows, no gradients except the floor light under product photos.
Signal green means one thing: connected or on right now.
Selection is shown in ink (inverted cell), never in a signal colour.
One variable face (Archivo), differentiated by width rather than by family.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Signal green means "connected or on right now" and is never used for selection, emphasis, hover, focus, links or decoration. If a green element would still be green with the device unplugged, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Ink Selects Rule
rules.body: Selection and the chosen option are shown by inverting a cell to label ink with graphite text (segmented controls, EQ band cells, the default DPI stage, the selected EQ node). Live state and selection can coexist on one element without colliding.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight on one family, not from a second typeface. Captions are condensed, values semi-condensed, reading text normal width.

rules.name: The Caption Belongs To A Value Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps sit directly above or beside the value or control they name (plate cell, field, callout, rail item). They are never used as a free-standing eyebrow over a heading.

rules.name: The No Reflow Rule
rules.body: Plate cells sit on a fixed grid and long values truncate, so a hardware change rewrites a value without moving anything around it.

rules.name: The Nothing Glows Rule
rules.body: No coloured shadows, no outer glows, no gradient fills. The single permitted gradient is the faint radial floor light (label ink at 7% alpha) under each home product photo.

dos: **Do** put live device state on a rating plate: condensed caps caption over a firm tabular value, in ruled cells that never reflow.
**Do** reserve signal green for state that is connected or on right now, and flash a plate value yellow in place when the hardware changes it.
**Do** show selection by inverting to label ink with graphite text.
**Do** keep corners at 3px (2px for knobs and small icon buttons, 4px for rail items) and dividers at 1px hairlines.
**Do** differentiate type by Archivo's width axis and weight, with tabular figures everywhere values change.
**Do** keep depth tonal: chrome darker than the ground, panels one step lighter.
donts: **Don't** use signal green for selection, hover, focus, links, headings or decoration.
**Don't** add glows, coloured shadows, or gradient fills; the floor light under product photos is the only gradient.
**Don't** bring back the old violet-to-blue gradient, near-black glowing tiles, or tracked uppercase labels used as decoration.
**Don't** use condensed caps as a standalone eyebrow over a heading; a caption always names a value or control.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface for display or labels.
**Don't** run mouse callout leaders at any angle other than 0 or 90 degrees.
